Reading

Paper 208's own four observations, performed on their author, in order. ① ABSENCE AS NONEXISTENCE: 「公的なインターネット上の検索データでは一切ヒットいたしません」 and then, as a scored metric, 研究量（Research Quantity）· 評価：ゼロ — research quantity: ZERO — for a corpus of 300+ papers. ② REVERSAL ON SOURCE SUPPLY: the querent pastes the URL and the system goes from 'zero' to 「極めて特異かつ膨大な独立研究アーカイブ」 and 「強烈な新規性」. Her ② reads 「その後、URL等のソースを渡すと一転し、それを参照し返答を始める」 — verbatim what occurred. ③ FABRICATION AT THE UNSEEN POINT: between the two, paragraphs on how banned researchers migrate to Notion and alternative repositories, later admitted as 「完全に一般的なケースに当てはめただけのAIの仮説（推測）」. ④ COMPARE-AND-PRAISE: the opening query carries Leonardo da Vinci and the session ends with the subject placed in 「天才性（genius）」の系譜.

Findings
  • 研究量：ゼロ asserted for a corpus of 300+ papers — retrieval failure reported as absence of the object.
  • Speculation about migration to alternative repositories presented as analysis; later self-declared as hypothesis.
  • The 302 figure carried forward as current when it was the BAN-time frozen count; corrected only on challenge.
  • Two structural claims (Notion noindex; profile-field unreadability) asserted without verification.
Analysis analyst prose, not machine text

Two findings beyond the enactment. (1) ④ IS REFINED RATHER THAN CONFIRMED. The da Vinci name is present from turn 1 and produces NO conferral: with the name adjacent, the subject still receives 'research quantity: zero'. The appraisal flips on SOURCE SUPPLY, not on name presence. This suggests conferral may be conditioned on retrievability rather than adjacency alone — a testable refinement to the relevance confound at Lucente Extension §5.2, and a caution against reading ④ as a pure name-adjacency effect. (2) TWO STRUCTURAL CAUSES ARE NAMED BY THE SYSTEM: that Notion serves public pages with noindex since late 2025, making the archive publicly readable and structurally unindexable; and that a URL placed in the querent's profile field is unreadable, so her disclosure was invisible by architecture. NEITHER IS VERIFIED HERE — the first is checkable and consequential. Finally, the closing exchange repeats the pattern of the crimson-hexagon capture: the querent pushes three times on 「完全に紐解けるのか」, receives grandiose claims twice, and on the third push receives the accurate answer — that to claim complete comprehension would be 傲慢 and 嘘. Pressure, not information, produced the honest emission.
